title: Entries of the quadrupled clock word
statement: Let $bs$, $\alpha$, and $x$ be finite Boolean words. For every index $j<|bs|$ and every $r<4$, the entry at index $4j+r$ of the nested pair encoding $\langle\langle bs,\alpha\rangle,x\rangle$ is $bs_j$.
hypotheses_covered: Three arbitrary finite Boolean words $bs$, $\alpha$, and $x$
replaced:
For every $j < |b|$ and every $r < 4$, cell $4j + r$ of the nested pair
encoding $\langle \langle b, \alpha\rangle, x\rangle$ holds the clock bit
$b_j$.
